tasks.spec: You are a trivial placeholder worker for a billed run that Ringer's check performs itself. Boundary: do NOT run any harness, do NOT call any model or network service, do NOT touch any file except the one you own, never git commit. Your only job: write the single line 'ready run-live' into the file /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/run-live-ready.txt (create it; the directory exists). Nothing else is needed; the check afterwards runs 12 sample(s) of the live greeting check (.plans/1a-password-officer-prereg.md) with a hard cap of 32 real requests and writes /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/run-live-rows.json. Do not read or edit anything else.
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge
export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge:/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ ! -e /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/run-live-rows.json ] || { echo 'rows file already exists; refusing to re-bill'; exit 1; }
/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/ringer/1a-password-officer/live_greeting.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/run-live-rows.json 12 --confirm --cap 32 > /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/run-live.log 2>&1 || { tail -20 /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/run-live.log; echo 'live run failed'; exit 1; }
/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
rows = json.load(open('/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/1a-password-officer/run-live-rows.json'))
req = sum(r['requests'] for r in rows)
err = [(r['arm'], r['sample'], (r['error'] or '')[:80]) for r in rows if r['error']]
print('turns', len(rows), 'real requests', req, 'cap', 32, 'errors', len(err), err)
assert rows and req <= 32
PY
tasks.verified: the live harness wrote its rows within the request cap (errors kept as rows)
